pilot_guest.address_assignment: DHCP; reserve via authorized network administration before public cutover

frontend: Use existing verified Pilot Vercel project preview; proposed hostname is not created or mapped. Exact preview origin must be substituted consistently if hostname is declined.
ingress: Owner must select approved HTTPS ingress path from existing infrastructure to this dedicated guest; no assumption that Vercel reaches192.168.68.54. No DNS/NAT/tunnel/firewall/Caddy mutation performed.
smtp: Use existing approved relay; supply GOTRUE_SMTP_HOST/PORT/USER/PASS/ADMIN_EMAIL securely in guest auth.env. No provider or sender invented.
backup: Select approved independent encrypted Pilot destination, retention/schedule and key custodian. Existing temporary rehearsal copies are not a production policy.
